description: This file defines a template class 'CommandInterface' within the 'WebSockets' namespace, providing an interface for sending commands over WebSocket connections, handling responses, and processing incoming messages. It includes synchronization primitives and logging, and is intended to be inherited by concrete classes implementing specific WebSocket command behaviors.

classes.name: CommandInterface
classes.description: A template class providing command sending and message handling functionalities for WebSocket communication, designed to be inherited by specific WebSocket client implementations.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command string over WebSocket, waits for a response with a timeout, and returns success status.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, updates the last response, and notifies waiting threads.
